fullTextEN: Hello!
You know, I am Chinese,
but I live in Australia.
So, today I want to talk about

fullTextZH: 我在澳大利亚的有趣发现。
fullTextEN: my interesting discoveries in Australia.
The first is I found

fullTextZH: 澳大利亚的牛奶很便宜、很便宜。
fullTextEN: milk in Australia is very cheap, very cheap.
You can spend one dollar, two dollars,
eighty cents, seventy cents to buy
milk.

fullTextZH: 澳大利亚的牛奶很便宜，
fullTextEN: Milk in Australia is very cheap,
but it's very tasty.

fullTextZH: 第二个是澳大利亚人不喜欢星巴克。
fullTextEN: The second is Australians don't like Starbucks.

fullTextZH: 在澳大利亚，咖啡很好、很好，
fullTextEN: In Australia, coffee is very good, very good,

fullTextZH: 所以澳大利亚遍地都是咖啡馆。
fullTextEN: so Australia is full of cafes.

fullTextZH: 所以，星巴克在澳大利亚的生意不好。
fullTextEN: So, Starbucks doesn't do well in Australia.

fullTextZH: 在澳大利亚，很多星巴克关门倒闭，
fullTextEN: In Australia, many Starbucks have closed down,

fullTextZH: 因为澳大利亚人不喜欢星巴克。
fullTextEN: because Australians don't like Starbucks.

fullTextZH: 第三个是，如果你去澳大利亚的超市，
fullTextEN: The third is, if you go to an Australian supermarket,

fullTextZH: 你会发现很多、很多东西半价。
fullTextEN: you will find many, many things at half price.

fullTextZH: 在中国，如果一个东西半价，
fullTextEN: In China, if something is half price,
it might be because this item
is about to expire,

fullTextZH: 可能因为这个东西卖得不好。
fullTextEN: or because it doesn't sell well.
But in Australia,
many, many things are half price,
not because they are about to expire,
not because they don't sell well,

fullTextZH: 所以你可以放心买很多、很多。
fullTextEN: so you can buy a lot with peace of mind.

fullTextZH: 第四个，澳大利亚的产品常常写：
fullTextEN: Fourth, Australian products often say:

fullTextZH: “如果你对这个东西不是百分之百满意，
fullTextEN: "If you are not 100% satisfied with this item,
you can return it,
or get a refund."
I find it very interesting,
because in China,

fullTextZH: 一般来说，你不可以退款。
fullTextEN: generally speaking, you can't get a refund.
Maybe if the item is bad,
you can return it.

fullTextZH: 第五个，如果你去澳大利亚超市，
fullTextEN: Fifth, if you go to an Australian supermarket,

fullTextZH: 你发现标价和你付的价格不一样，
fullTextEN: and you find the listed price is different from what you pay,

fullTextZH: 你可以告诉他们，他们会退钱给你，
fullTextEN: You can tell them, they will refund you,

fullTextZH: 他们还会把东西免费送给你。
fullTextEN: They will also send the items to you for free.
I bought two things,
One is nuts,
One is cabbage.
The prices of the two items are incorrect,

fullTextZH: 所以我告诉他们，他们把钱给我，
fullTextEN: So I told them, they gave me the money,

fullTextZH: 然后给我这两个东西，不要钱。
fullTextEN: Then gave me these two things for free.
The sixth is, in Australia,
Tips can be given,
Or not given.

fullTextZH: 在澳大利亚，服务员的工资很高，
fullTextEN: In Australia, waiters' wages are high,
So you can give,
Or not give.

fullTextZH: 所以，如果你很喜欢他的服务，
fullTextEN: So, if you really like their service,
You can tip them.

fullTextZH: 第七个，我发现在澳大利亚，
fullTextEN: The seventh, I found in Australia,

fullTextZH: 房租可以一个星期一个星期付。
fullTextEN: Rent can be paid weekly.

fullTextZH: 可能因为很多人的工资也是一个星期
fullTextEN: Possibly because many people's wages are also weekly
Paid weekly.
In China,

fullTextZH: 房租不可以一个星期一个星期付。
fullTextEN: Rent cannot be paid week by week.

fullTextZH: 在中国，在北京，房租3个月
fullTextEN: In China, in Beijing, rent is for 3 months
Paid every 3 months.
In Chinese, we say ⬆️
It's one month's deposit,
3 months' rent.

fullTextZH: 所以，在北京租房很难、很难。
fullTextEN: So, renting in Beijing is very difficult.

fullTextZH: 还有，在澳大利亚，房租的合同
fullTextEN: Also, in Australia, rental contracts
might be three months,
might be 6 months,
might be a year.

fullTextZH: 在北京，我觉得最少一年。
fullTextEN: In Beijing, I think at least a year.
The eighth is Australians
really like 'small talk'.

fullTextZH: 如果你见到一个陌生人，
fullTextEN: If you meet a stranger,
they will also say to you:
"Hey! Hello! How are you?"

fullTextZH: 可是，我觉得在中国，我们没有这个。
fullTextEN: But, I think in China, we don't have this.

fullTextZH: 第九个是澳大利亚人很喜欢走走。
fullTextEN: The ninth is Australians really like to walk.

fullTextZH: 在中国，有一个词是“散步”，
fullTextEN: In China, there is a word 'sanbu',

fullTextZH: 可是这个词一般来说是你吃晚饭，
fullTextEN: but this word generally means you eat dinner,

fullTextZH: 然后你觉得：“啊！很饱、很饱，
fullTextEN: then you feel: 'Ah! So full, so full,
so you want to go for a walk.'
You want to go to the park for a walk,
so you can digest.
But in Australia,
everyone likes to walk,
go to the park for a walk,
go to the beach for a walk.
In Australia, walking
is almost a sport.
But in China,
walking is not a sport.

fullTextZH: 好，这就是我在澳大利亚的有趣发现。
fullTextEN: Okay, this is my interesting discovery in Australia.
Do you think these are strange?
Leave a comment and tell me!
Thank you, goodbye!
